guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Fund a Wallet and Bridge to Ink
guide.description: You need ETH for Ink gas and USDT0 to trade or deposit. Buy ETH and stablecoins on Binance , then move them to the Ink network using the bridge widget below or another bridge that supports Ink. Keep a small ETH balance for transaction fees. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Create Your Nado Account
guide.description: Go to the Nado app and connect an EVM-compatible wallet such as MetaMask or Rabby. Season 2 opened to everyone, so you can sign up directly without a referral code.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Deposit Collateral
guide.description: Send USDT0 to your Nado account to use as margin. The unified margin system lets one balance support multiple spot and perpetual positions, so you do not need separate accounts for each market.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade Spot and Perpetual Markets
guide.description: Open positions across the Nado markets to earn points. Points reward genuine market participation rather than raw volume, so trading, posting limit orders as a maker, and supporting liquidations all count. Wash trading and self-matching can reduce or zero out your allocation for that week.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Provide Liquidity to the NLP Vault
guide.description: Deposit USDT0 into the NLP vault to earn points based on your average proportional share during each weekly epoch. The vault supplies liquidity to the orderbook and earns a cut of trading fees and liquidation proceeds, so you collect yield alongside points.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Use Tokenized Equities as Collateral
guide.description: Deposit SPYx or QQQx to hold spot exposure to US markets while trading from one portfolio. You can also borrow USDT0 against these positions and open BTC, ETH, or SOL perps, since Nado evaluates spot balances, perp positions, and borrowed liabilities under a single portfolio margin. Learn how to deposit xStocks on Nado .
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Refer Active Traders
guide.description: Share your referral link from the Referrals page. You earn referral points only when the people you invite actually trade, so the rewards track real usage rather than sign-ups.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Track Points and Trading Tier
guide.description: Check the points page to monitor your weekly points, ranking, and Trading Tier. Tiers range from Breeze at the bottom to Tornado at the top and influence future NLP eligibility, so consistent weekly activity matters more than a single large session. Full mechanics are in the documentation .
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
